SELECT
	documentcode = 'SV-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), SL.SaleInvCode))),
	SaleType = 1, 
	invcode = SL.saleinvcode,    
	headerno=SL.headerno,
	headerinvNo = SL.headerinvNo,    
	date = SL.date,    
	flatdisc = SL.flatdisc, 
	salestax = SL.salestax,       
	misccharges = SL.misccharges, 
	invdiscperc = SL.discperc,
	invgstperc1 = SL.invgstperc1 ,
	doctype = Case SL.salecatcode When 1 Then 'Cash' When 2 Then 'Credit' Else 'Cash' End, 
	customername = A.name, 
	amount =  Round(Sum ( SD.looseqty * SD.saleprice), 2),    
	itemdiscpercvalue = Round(Sum (( SD.looseqty  * (SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc) * (SD.discperc * .01)) + (SD.looseqty  * SD.itemflatdisc)), 2),    
	invdiscpercvalue = Sum (Round( SD.looseqty   * (SD.saleprice  - SD.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (SD.discperc * .01)),2)) * (SL.discperc /100),
	itemsalestax = Sum (Round (SD.looseqty * SD.unitsalestax + Round ( Round (SD.looseqty * (SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc ) * (1 - SD.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * SD.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) ),
	salesman = U.username,
	Discount = Round(Sum (( SD.looseqty  * (SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc) * (SD.discperc * .01)) + (SD.looseqty  * SD.itemflatdisc)), 2)+
	Sum (Round( SD.looseqty   * (SD.saleprice  - SD.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (SD.discperc * .01)),2)) * (SL.discperc /100) + 
	SL.flatdisc,
	A.AliasName,
	CashAmt = ISNULL(Case When SL.salecatcode <> 3 Then SL.Amt ELSE 0 End, 0) + 
		ISNULL((SELECT SUM(SRA.DEBIT - SRA.Credit) 
		FROM SaleReceivableAdj SRA 
		WHERE SRA.SaleInvCode = SL.SaleInvCode AND 
			SRA.AccCode IN 
			(SELECT AccCode FROM Accounts 
			WHERE SubCode IN (SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = 'GT_CashSub'))), 0) +
		ISNULL(SL.CashCharged, 0),
	CreditCardAmt = ISNULL((SELECT SUM(SRA.DEBIT - SRA.Credit) 
		FROM SaleReceivableAdj SRA 
		WHERE SRA.SaleInvCode = SL.SaleInvCode AND 
			SRA.DEBIT > 0 AND
			SRA.AccCode IN 
			(SELECT AccCode FROM Accounts 
			WHERE SubCode IN (SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = 'GT_BankSub'))), 0) +
		ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CW.Amount) 
				FROM CashierWindow CW
				WHERE CW.SaleInvCode = SL.SaleInvCode), 0),
	OtherAmt = ISNULL((SELECT SUM(SRA.DEBIT - SRA.Credit) 
		FROM SaleReceivableAdj SRA 
		WHERE SRA.SaleInvCode = SL.SaleInvCode AND 
			SRA.AccCode <> SL.CustCode AND
			SRA.AccCode NOT IN 
			(SELECT AccCode FROM Accounts 
			WHERE SubCode IN (SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name IN ('GT_CashSub', 'GT_BankSub')))), 0),
	Posted = SL.Posted,
	SalesPerson = (SELECT SM.Name FROM SalesMan SM WHERE SM.SalesManCode = SL.SManCode),
	Remarks=SL.Remarks
FROM 
	dbo.saleledger SL, 
	dbo.saledetail SD,   
	dbo.accounts A,
	dbo.users U  
WHERE 
	( SL.saleinvcode = SD.saleinvcode ) and  
	( SL.custcode = A.acccode )and  
	( SL.salesmancode = U.usercode )and  
	( SL.date between :ar_StartDate and :ar_EndDate) 
GROUP BY 
	SL.saleinvcode,   
	SL.headerno,
	SL.headerinvNo,
	SL.CustCode,
	SL.date,   
	SL.misccharges,   
	SL.flatdisc,   
	SL.discperc,  
	SL.salestax, 
	SL.invgstperc1,
	SL.salecatcode, 
	SL.Amt,
	SL.CashCharged,
	SL.InvTotal,
	A.name,
	A.AliasName,
	U.username,
	SL.Posted,
	SL.SManCode,
	SL.Remarks
UNION ALL

table.sort: c_header A, saletype A, invcode A, date A

objects.name: c_totalsaletaxvalue
objects.expression: if( ( doctype ="Cash-R" OR doctype ="Credit-R" OR doctype ="Retail-R")  , -1 ,  1 ) *  Round (itemsalestax  + Round( Round( amount  -  itemdiscpercvalue  -  invdiscpercvalue   -   flatdisc  ,0) * 0.01 *  invgstperc1 ,2), 0)

objects.name: compute_13
objects.visible: 1	if(if(saletype=1, 1, -1) * sum(  Round ( (amount  -   itemdiscpercvalue  -  invdiscpercvalue  - flatdisc   +   misccharges),  0)  +  c_totaltaxval  for all)=0,0,1)
objects.expression: sum(if(saletype=1, 1, -1) * Round ( (amount  -   itemdiscpercvalue  -  invdiscpercvalue  - flatdisc   +   misccharges),  0)  +  c_totaltaxval  for all)

objects.name: compute_17
objects.visible: 1	if(sum( if(saletype=1, 1, -1) * (netamount - cashamt - creditcardamt - otheramt)  for all)=0,0,1)
objects.expression: sum( if(saletype=1, 1, -1) * (netamount - cashamt - creditcardamt - otheramt)  for all)

objects.name: c_totaltaxval
objects.expression: Round (itemsalestax  + Round( Round( amount  -  itemdiscpercvalue  -  invdiscpercvalue   -   flatdisc  ,0) * 0.01 *  invgstperc1 ,2), 0)

objects.name: netamount
objects.visible: 1	if(  Round ( (amount  -   itemdiscpercvalue  -  invdiscpercvalue  - flatdisc   +   misccharges),  0)  +  c_totaltaxval  = 0, 0, 1)
objects.expression: Round ( (amount  -   itemdiscpercvalue  -  invdiscpercvalue  - flatdisc   +   misccharges),  0)  +  c_totaltaxval

objects.name: compute_8
objects.visible: 1	if(if(saletype=1, 1, -1) * sum(  Round ( (amount  -   itemdiscpercvalue  -  invdiscpercvalue  - flatdisc   +   misccharges),  0)  +  c_totaltaxval  for group 1)=0,0,1)
objects.expression: sum(if(saletype=1, 1, -1) * Round ( (amount  -   itemdiscpercvalue  -  invdiscpercvalue  - flatdisc   +   misccharges),  0)  +  c_totaltaxval  for group 1)

objects.name: compute_12
objects.visible: 1	if(sum( if(saletype=1, 1, -1) * (netamount - cashamt - creditcardamt - otheramt)  for group 1)=0,0,1)
objects.expression: sum( if(saletype=1, 1, -1) * (netamount - cashamt - creditcardamt - otheramt) for group 1)

objects.name: compute_21
objects.visible: 1	if(sum(  Round ( (amount  -   itemdiscpercvalue  -  invdiscpercvalue  - flatdisc   +   misccharges),  0)  +  c_totaltaxval  for group 2)=0,0,1)
objects.expression: sum(  Round ( (amount  -   itemdiscpercvalue  -  invdiscpercvalue  - flatdisc   +   misccharges),  0)  +  c_totaltaxval  for group 2)
